name: gizza-ai/extract-tar
summary: List and extract files from a tar / tar.gz / tgz archive.

tool.description: List and extract the files from a tar, tar.gz, or tgz archive, returning them repacked as a ZIP (gzip is auto-detected). The response lists every member (files and directories). Provide the archive as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Paths are sanitized (no absolute paths or '..' traversal).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
